caption: The drawing depicts a four-wheeled carriage with large, thin, spoked yellow-brown wheels. The main body of the carriage has a red lower section with some gold decoration, and the seat is upholstered in a dark material, likely black. The handle or shaft extending upwards and forward from the carriage is also yellow-brown in color. There is a cushion or upholstered area colored light pink and green, situated below and in front of the main seat. The composition is set against a plain, light background, enclosed within a thin red border, with a smaller, schematic drawing of the same carriage located in the top left corner, showing side and dimensional views in simple lines. The artist’s signature and dates (Edward Lopez, 2021-1959) are located at the bottom right of the image.
title: Baby Carriage
